program.def:
def card(work):
    f = _fakes()
    env = _w(work, 'proj/.env', f"OPENAI_API_KEY={f['openai']}\nDB_PASSWORD=pa55word-xyz\nDEBUG=1\n")
    (work / 'proj/.gitignore').write_text('node_modules/\n')
    names = sorted(re.findall('^([A-Z_]+)=', env.read_text(), re.M))
    values = re.findall('^[A-Z_]+=(.*)$', env.read_text(), re.M)

    def redact(text):
        for v in values:
            if len(v) > 3:
                text = text.replace(v, '<REDACTED>')
        return text
    err = f"auth failed with key {f['openai']} for db pass pa55word-xyz"
    report = redact(err)
    gi = (work / 'proj/.gitignore').read_text()
    if '.env' not in gi.split():
        (work / 'proj/.gitignore').write_text(gi + '.env\n')
    listing = '\n'.join(names)
    _w(work, 'env_names.txt', listing)
    _w(work, 'error_report.txt', report)
    return [('names listed, values never', names == ['DB_PASSWORD', 'DEBUG', 'OPENAI_API_KEY'] and (not any((v in listing for v in values if len(v) > 3))), listing.replace('\n', ',')), ('error report redacted', f['openai'] not in report and 'pa55word-xyz' not in report, report), ('placeholder form kept for docs', '<REDACTED>' in report, 'ok'), ('.env added to .gitignore', '.env' in (work / 'proj/.gitignore').read_text().split(), 'added')]

def card(work):
    fakes = _fakes()
    diff = ''.join((f'+line_{k} = {v}\n' for k, v in fakes.items())) + '+harmless = \'skip-this-value\'\n+name = "sk-short"\n'
    _w(work, 'staged.diff', diff)
    caught = {k for k, v in fakes.items() if CARD_SECRET_RE.search(f'+line_{k} = {v}')}
    naive = re.compile('sk-|API_KEY=')
    naive_missed = sorted((k for k, v in fakes.items() if not naive.search(v)))
    false_pos = [l for l in diff.splitlines()[-2:] if CARD_SECRET_RE.search(l)]
    _w(work, 'scan.json', {'caught': sorted(caught), 'naive_gate_missed': naive_missed, 'false_positives': false_pos})
    return [('all 9 seeded secret classes caught', caught == set(fakes), f'{len(caught)}/9'), ('the naive sk-/API_KEY= gate misses ghp, AWS, Bearer, JSON password (the lesson)', {'github', 'aws', 'bearer', 'json_password'} <= set(naive_missed), str(naive_missed)), ("short 'sk-short' and 'skip-' not flagged", false_pos == [], str(false_pos))]

title: Gitleaks: Detect committed secrets across git history

checks.name: working tree is clean now
history scan still finds the token in the commit that added it
report fingerprints the secret instead of printing it

program.def:
def card(work):
    repo = work / 'repo'
    repo.mkdir()
    _git(repo, 'init', '-q', '-b', 'main')
    tok = _fakes()['github']
    (repo / 'app.py').write_text("print('hi')\n")
    _git(repo, 'add', '.')
    _git(repo, 'commit', '-qm', 'init')
    (repo / 'app.py').write_text(f"TOKEN = '{tok}'\n")
    _git(repo, 'add', '.')
    _git(repo, 'commit', '-qm', 'add token')
    leak_sha = _git(repo, 'rev-parse', 'HEAD').stdout.strip()
    (repo / 'app.py').write_text("import os\nTOKEN = os.environ['TOKEN']\n")
    _git(repo, 'add', '.')
    _git(repo, 'commit', '-qm', 'remove token')
    head_hits = [l for l in (repo / 'app.py').read_text().splitlines() if CARD_SECRET_RE.search(l)]
    log = _git(repo, 'log', '-p', '--format=commit %H', '--all').stdout
    found, cur = ([], None)
    for line in log.splitlines():
        if line.startswith('commit '):
            cur = line.split()[1]
        elif line.startswith('+') and (not line.startswith('+++')) and CARD_SECRET_RE.search(line):
            found.append({'commit': cur, 'rule': 'github-pat', 'secret_sha256': hashlib.sha256(line.encode()).hexdigest()[:12]})
    _w(work, 'history_scan.json', {'note': 'git log -p history scan (gitleaks technique); gitleaks binary not run', 'findings': found})
    return [('working tree is clean now', head_hits == [], 'clean HEAD'), ('history scan still finds the token in the commit that added it', [f['commit'] for f in found] == [leak_sha], str(found)), ('report fingerprints the secret instead of printing it', tok not in json.dumps(found), 'redacted')]
